archive.selected_by: YouTube former platform-curated trending lists, not probability sampling of ordinary public videos
limitations: 78.4 million country/timestamp ranked entries contain repeated video IDs, not 78.4 million independent uploads or people.
A country-specific trending list is a platform-curated visibility surface, not a count of unique viewers residing in that country.
Video metadata language is not the spoken language or audience language and is not a census of all memes or humor.
Public Trending pages retired on 2025-07-01; longitudinal historical visibility cannot be treated as an active 2026 distribution channel.

categorization_protocol.definition: Original scripted comic performance or recurring gag
Public reaction or commentary about a source clip
Adaptation of another meme, character or cultural reference
Explanatory content about community stories, characters, lore or jokes
Brief edited humorous montage or audio/text template

inference_restrictions: A trending appearance does not classify a video as a meme: content coding and publicly documented taxonomy are required.
The survey's 78% perceived meme visibility is not a measured 78% meme-viewing rate.
The survey's 69% watching niche content and 71% watching lore cannot be added because respondents and activities overlap.
Trending appearance in multiple countries is not evidence that people migrated between countries, languages or channels.
Ranks in the historical pre-July-2025 curated list cannot estimate present-day Shorts recommendations or future income.
No source estimates the number of small meme creators, their hourly wages or monetized fan purchases.
